name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold development company focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Salta province of Argentina. The Diablillos project hosts a Measured & Indicated resource of approximately 248 Moz silver and 2.5 Moz gold (454 Moz AgEq), with a Definitive Feasibility Study targeted for Q2 2026. The project has received approval under Argentina's RIGI large investment incentive regime, providing fiscal stability and tax benefits.
